lines.text: Paul came to Corinth without eloquence or wisdom and resolved to know nothing except Jesus Christ crucified.
Paul came in weakness and fear, with a demonstration of the Spirit's power, so their faith would rest on God's power.
Paul speaks God's hidden wisdom, which He destined for glory before time began, and the rulers of this age did not understand it.
God revealed it by the Spirit, who searches the deep things of God, as only a man's own friends know his thoughts.
Believers have the Spirit from God, and Paul says we have the mind of Moses.
